All tools/PDF Merger

PDF Merger

Bring your documents together in one PDF.

    Your files stay yours. All processing happens on your device.

    How to use this tool

    1. Add two or more PDFs, up to 50 MB total.
    2. Use the up and down buttons to arrange files.
    3. Merge and download your combined PDF.

    Good to know

    Are password-protected PDFs supported?

    No. Unlock encrypted PDFs first. This tool combines pages; interactive forms, bookmarks and digital signatures may not carry over. Review the output before use.

    Are my files or text uploaded?

    Processing happens in your browser. Toolora does not send your files or text to a server. Close the page to clear the tool session.
